summary: Route stalled approval to managed publication recovery

delivery.outcome: Make existing approval diagnostics resolve to a bounded managed-publication recovery recipe, with regression coverage and no new gate.
nonGoals: No direct author approval or merge, weakened checks, new runtime service or ticket database.
No historical work cleanup, Taskand implementation change or fleet adoption claim.

architecture.decision: Reuse the canonical diagnostic catalog and error runbook format; the existing publisher and protected Validator own effects. Navigation and test coverage change, not authority.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded catalog, runbook and test changes; existing approval policy and receipts stay unchanged.

validation.evidence: Every existing approval code resolves to the canonical runbook; exact-subject and trust boundaries are preserved.
Regression checks cover observation-before-retry, protected handoff and separate publication stages; existing negative governance tests still reject invalid approval.
